text:
vivian: Quick heads-up: deploying routing-optimizer-v1. Feature flag routing-optimizer-v1-ff will be ramped in us-west-only first. Change window 3h. Release notes: https://go/release/2026-03-routing-opt :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary started cr-7221. Initial 1% traffic to v1 in us-west. Dashboard: https://dash/redwood/canary/cr-7221
omar: Monitoring rules: p95 > baseline + 120ms OR error rate >0.3% -> immediate rollback. Also watch token throughput (if >30% delta pause ramp).

leo: Prepared rollback pin: tag=v0-pin-2026-03-21. Rollback commands ready in runbook. I pre-warmed edge caches.

vivian: Applying staged rollout with holdpoints. Plan snippet:
feature_flag: routing-optimizer-v1-ff
rollout:
  - t0: 1%
  - t+12m: 5%  # hold 15m
  - t+50m: 20% # hold 30m
  - manual: 100%
slo_triggers:
  p95_latency_ms: 120
  error_rate_pct: 0.3
  token_throughput_pct: 30

deploy-bot: t+15m metrics: p95 +28ms, errors nominal. Advancing to 5% in us-west.

infra-bot: KV warmup kicked for v1 in us-west, status=started.

omar: seeing a small tail latency spike in us-west-2b. Not at trigger. Keep AZ-level pin ready.

leo: If spike sustains 15m I'll pin that AZ back to v0. Pin command: `/route override --az us-west-2b --service router --pin v0 --tag v0-pin-2026-03-21`.

vivian: Do that if needed. No global ramp until 30m stable at 5%.
deploy-bot: At t+48m metrics stable at 20% target window pending manual approval. Holdpoints respected.

vivian: Manual approval granted. Final checks green from oncall.
deploy-bot: Flag set to 100% in us-west. Canary cr-7221 closed success. Scheduling eu/apac rollout in next 90m with same holdpoints. Release notes updated: https://go/release/2026-03-routing-opt#done

omar: Follow-ups: monitor token throughput and cache hit-rate for 24h. Rollback pin v0-pin-2026-03-21 held for 72h.

leo: Added AZ-drain steps to runbook and annotated calendar. Nice work team.
